answer: Minimum Path Diversity Routing Agents route computational payloads through a multi-hop network resembling a coral reef. The protocol measures the electrical copper resistance of the communication paths by tracking packet transmission latency variance across disjoint subnetworks. If an attacker floods the system with fake nodes, those nodes inevitably cluster into isolated local loops instead of bridging wide tracts of the network ocean. The enforcement rule drops all packets traversing paths where the route diversity falls below a strict threshold.
